Several days (the swan feathers and the cloak require 20-hour waits)

The fae, nature spirits that hide in animals, trees and stones, ask for your help to prove you are worthy of entering the secret island of {wiki:Feyrist|Feyrist}. After helping animals all over the continent, you gain access to Feyrist, find a fairy treasure, rebuild the magic barrier against the nightmares of Roshamuul and finally make your way to {wiki:Candia|Candia}. You receive, among others, {item:Butterfly Ring}, {item:Blossom Bag}, {item:Sun Catcher}, {item:Moon Mirror}, {item:Starlight Vial} and {item:Swan Feather Cloak}.
The nightmares living in Roshamuul threaten the peaceful existence of Feyrist's inhabitants.
Alkestios, southwest of the Ab'Dendriel gates

For *Sweet Dreams*: have finished *A Dream Come True*; access to the boss {creature:The Flaming Orchid} (requires the {wiki:Asura Palace Quest|Asura Palace Quest}); access to the boss {creature:Katex Blood Tongue} (requires the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest|Blood Brothers Quest} up to mission 3 and the missions *The Curse Spreads* and *An Ancient Feud* of the {wiki:Grimvale Quest|Grimvale Quest}).
For *The Swan Feather Cloak*: have finished *A Dream Come True*.
To ask for the {item:Empty Starlight Vial} and the {item:Dark Sun Catcher} in *A Dream Come True*: have finished *An Unlikely Couple*.
Troubled Animals / Beset Stones (buy in Venore)
or {item:Small Emerald}, {item:Small Ruby} or {item:Small Sapphire}: one gem per trip to Feyrist through the shrines
Any melee weapon (to break the fairies' energy barriers)
Sweet Dreams (picked up in Feyrist at night)
7,000 gp in cash: 5,000 for Ahmet, 1,000 for Irmana and 1,000 for Charlotta
Optional: {item:Orc Tooth}, {item:Shark Teeth}, {item:Vampire Teeth}, {item:Perfect Behemoth Fang}, {item:Carrion Worm Fang} and {item:Werewolf Fangs} for the Tooth Fairy
Access to {wiki:Feyrist|Feyrist} through the elemental shrines
one for each tooth handed to the Tooth Fairy (optional)
Access to {wiki:Candia|Candia} and the ability to trade with {npc:Coco} and {npc:Toffee}
At the end of *Troubled Animals* (after *The Swan Maiden*), when {npc:Alkestios} marks you with the fae seal.
Each trip through the shrines uses up a {item:Small Amethyst}, {item:Small Emerald}, {item:Small Ruby} or {item:Small Sapphire}; you don't need a gem to come back.
In *Sweet Dreams*, when you make the {item:Gingerbread Key (Moon Melon, Raspberry and Lemon)} in Feyrist's oven.
You enter through the giant donut in the **east** of Feyrist.
With access to Candia: they are beneath the Gingerbread Castle.
Trades with Coco and Toffee (Candy Carnival)
In *Sweet Dreams*, after the chocolate mines, when the {npc:Sugar Plum Fairy} reopens the Candy Carnival.

Many parts only work at certain times of the Tibian day: the Ghostly Wolf and the moonlight and starlight collection are **at night**; the sun, the mosaics and the swan feathers in Feyrist are **by day**. Check the time before you travel.
The fae are peaceful: Alkestios asks you **not to kill the poachers** to solve his problem.
Do *An Unlikely Couple* before or during *A Dream Come True*: you need it to receive the {item:Empty Starlight Vial} and the {item:Dark Sun Catcher}.
Start collecting {item:Swan Feather|Swan Feathers} as soon as you have access to Feyrist: you can only pick up 40 per day (5 at each of the 8 spots, every 20 hours).
Always keep a small gem ({item:Small Amethyst}, {item:Small Emerald}, {item:Small Ruby} or {item:Small Sapphire}) to travel to Feyrist.
{npc:Alkestios} is a fae who has taken the body of a white stag and is being hunted by poachers. You will scare them off with a false legend.

Go to {npc:Alkestios}, just southwest of the gates of **Ab'Dendriel**. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and accept with {key:yes}. He asks you to investigate the poachers' camp north of the Green Claw Swamps, without killing them.

Go to the entrance of the {wiki:Poacher Caves|Poacher Caves}, at {wiki:Ferngrims Gate|Ferngrims Gate}, north of the Green Claw Swamp: walk from Alkestios to the **southeast** (it is between Kazordoon, Venore and Ab'Dendriel). Inside, follow the **south** passages and go down to **floor -4**.
There are {creature:Poacher|Poachers}, {creature:Wolf|Wolves}, {creature:Bear|Bears} and {creature:Boar|Boars} on the way.
On floor -4, open the chest behind a door in the **south** part of the room. You receive the {item:Book with Old Legends}.
Chest with the Book with Old Legends (floor -4)
If you like, show the book to Alkestios ({key:book}): he explains that you need someone to add a legend about the bad luck of killing a white stag.

Go back the same way: climb the 4 floors through the same southern passages to the entrance at Ferngrims Gate. From there walk **northwest** to Ab'Dendriel (or **southeast** to Venore) to catch a boat.
Asking Ahmet to alter the book
Travel to **Ankrahmun** and talk to {npc:Ahmet}, the shopkeeper next to the bank. Say {key:hi}, {key:book} and {key:yes} to pay **5,000 gp**. You receive the {item:Book with Old Legends (Doctored)}.
Putting the book on the table

Go back to the Poacher Caves the same way (entrance at Ferngrims Gate, south passages, floor -4) and go to the room where you found the book. **Use** the {item:Book with Old Legends (Doctored)} on the table, right next to the dripping candles. The book disappears and the message *"You are placing the book on the table, hopefully the poachers will discover it soon."* appears.
Screenshot of this part of the mission (Poacher Caves)

Leave the Poacher Caves as the first time (climb the 4 floors to Ferngrims Gate) and walk back to {npc:Alkestios}, southwest of the Ab'Dendriel gates. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He sends you to see his sister, {npc:Ikassis}, in the northwest of Edron, next to a stone circle.

Travel to **Edron** and talk to {npc:Ikassis} (a snake). Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. She gives you a {item:Fae Talisman}, which lets you talk to animals, plants and stones, and sends you to look for the ghostly wolf in the south of **Cormaya**.

Cormaya is the island south of Edron. At Edron's north harbour talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:cormaya} and {key:yes} (20 gp). You disembark at Cormaya's north harbour, next to {npc:Pemaret}; from there walk **south** to the stone with the angry face.
Talking to the Ghostly Wolf (at night)

Go to Cormaya, next to the stone with the angry face, **at night** (Tibian time). Talk to the {npc:Ghostly Wolf}: {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. She tells you that a hunter took her three cubs to sell to the orcs of Ulderek's Rock.

Go back to Cormaya's north harbour and talk to {npc:Pemaret}: {key:hi}, {key:edron} and {key:yes} (20 gp) to return to Edron. From Edron take {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s boat to **Venore** ({key:venore}), the closest city to Ulderek's Rock.
Look for the young in Ulderek's Rock

Go to **Ulderek's Rock** (Orc Fortress), northwest of Venore, southeast of Ab'Dendriel and east of Ferngrims Gate: from Venore walk **northwest**. Inside the fort, **use** the {wiki:Pile of Bones (Quest)|pile of bones} next to the {wiki:Sleeping War Wolf|Sleeping War Wolf}. The message *"You discover a sleeping wolf in this tent. Could it be the one you are searching for?"* appears and you receive the {item:Notes of a Poacher}.
Pile of Bones next to the sleeping wolf
The fortress is full of orcs ({creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}, {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders}, etc.).
Leave the fort the same way you entered and walk back **southeast** to Venore. Do not stop to rest near the fort: the orcs roam in big groups.
Go to **Venore** and talk to {npc:Irmana}. Say {key:hi}, {key:fur} and {key:yes} to buy the {item:Fur of a Wolf Whelp} for **1,000 gp**.

Go back to Cormaya **at night**, as before (from Venore, boat to Edron and then {npc:Captain Seahorse} with {key:cormaya}). Say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to the {npc:Ghostly Wolf}. She asks you to put the fur in the stone's mouth.
Putting the fur on the stone and saying whelp
**Use** the {item:Fur of a Wolf Whelp} on the {item:Weeping Stone (Tears)} (*"You place the whelp fur in the stone's mouth and thus lay it to rest."*). Then say {key:whelp} to the Ghostly Wolf.
You can put the fur on the stone during the day, but the mission is only complete after you talk to the Ghostly Wolf (at night).

Leave Cormaya on {npc:Pemaret}'s boat ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}) and return to {npc:Ikassis} in Edron. Say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. She sends you to help a sister who is in swan form, in a small river southeast of there.
Talk to {npc:A Swan}, in Edron: {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. A troll stole her swan feather cloak and she got stuck in swan form.

If you want to follow the whole story, you can go to {npc:Chief Grarkharok} (the route is in the {wiki:Troll Sabotage Quest|Troll Sabotage Quest}) and ask {key:cloak}. He tells you he sold the cloak to Tereban. **This step is optional.**

Go to {npc:Tereban}, right above the Edron depot, and say {key:hi} and {key:cloak}. **This step is mandatory.** He explains that the cloak fell apart during a magic carpet flight from Edron to Darashia and that the feathers were scattered along the way.

Visit the five spots below. When you get near each pile of {item:Swan Feathers}, you receive a {item:Tattered Swan Feather} in your inventory. You need all **five**. Spot 1 is on foot, south of Edron. For the other four, take the flying carpet from {npc:Pino}, in Edron castle (above the north gate): {key:hi}, {key:darashia} and {key:yes}. To return to Edron, talk to {npc:Chemar}, on the Darashia carpet platform, and say {key:hi}, {key:edron} and {key:yes}.
1. South of Edron, on the grass next to the wheat
2. East of Darashia, in the rubbish bin
3. North of Darashia, stuck on the cactus spikes
4. North of Darashia, under the dragon skull
5. North of Darashia, under the dead tree (1 floor up)
In the desert north of Darashia there are {creature:Lion|Lions} and other desert creatures.
Handing the feathers to A Swan
Go back to {npc:A Swan} in Edron and say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to hand over the five feathers.
Go back to {npc:Alkestios} in Ab'Dendriel and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. He marks you with a fae seal: from now on you can use the elemental shrines to go to {wiki:Feyrist|Feyrist}.

Get a {item:Small Amethyst}, {item:Small Emerald}, {item:Small Ruby} or {item:Small Sapphire}. Each city has a corridor with four arches (ice, earth, fire and energy) that lead to the {wiki:Holy Shrine|Holy Shrines}; step into the arch of your gem's element and **use** the gem on the shrine inside (the gem is consumed). Each shrine takes you to a different place in Feyrist (for example, the {wiki:Ice Shrine|Ice Shrine} drops you on a beach).
Where the arches are in each city
The corridors with the four elemental arches are in these places:
Top floor of the depot tower
Top floor of the shops building, north of the depot
Lower floor of the Noodles Academy's central tower
Above the temple, up the stairs
To return to the mainland, **use** any of the four shrines in Feyrist (it does not matter which one you came in through) and you are teleported back. To leave you **do not need another gem**.
Four fae have hidden a treasure and each one guards a part of the map. This part can be done in parallel with the others.

Go to the {npc:Tooth Fairy}, south of the Suntower, outside Ab'Dendriel. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. She gives you {item:Present (Fairy)|presents} for three children who lost a milk tooth: Quero's daughter (Thais), Allen's son (Venore) and Rowenna's daughter (Carlin).

In each room: **use** the {wiki:Chest of Drawers (Quest)|chest of drawers} to pick up a {item:Milk Tooth} (*"You have found a milk tooth."*) and then **use** a {item:Present (Fairy)|present} on the bed next to it (*"You are placing the present for ... on the pillow."*). If you need to, ask the father/mother about {key:child}: the rooms are upstairs.

Go back to the {npc:Tooth Fairy} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. You receive the {item:Part of an Old Map (Upper Left)}. Ask about {key:parts} to find out where her brothers are (in the trees north of Carlin).

Say {key:cause} to the Tooth Fairy. She wants teeth for her collection. For each one you hand over you receive a {item:White Pearl}. After handing them all over and finishing the main mission you earn the achievement **Toothfairy Assistant**.
1 White Pearl per tooth; achievement Toothfairy Assistant
Telling a story to the Tired Tree

Go to the {npc:Tired Tree}, north of the Fields of Glory. Say {key:hi}, {key:map} and {key:yes}: she wants a bedtime story about dryads. The story is the book {wiki:The Seeds of Life (Book)|The Seeds of Life} (in the Ab'Dendriel library), but **you do not need to go there**. Say {key:mission} (or {key:map}) again and answer with the name of the book: {key:The Seeds of Life}.
If you do not have one yet, buy a {item:Rake} in **Venore**.
Go to the {npc:Grumpy Stone}, between Kazordoon and Femor Hills. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. Then **use** the {item:Rake} on the **5 stones** around the Grumpy Stone.
Say {key:mission} to the {npc:Grumpy Stone}. You receive the {item:Part of an Old Map (Upper Right)} and the clue to the last part: a {item:Big Fly Agaric} in the Fields of Glory.
Go to the {item:Big Fly Agaric} just south of the Tired Tree and use it: *"You discover the fourth map part between the big fly agaric's gills."*
**Use** the fourth part to put all the pieces together and get the {item:Old Map}. Use the map: it tells you to look for a stone mosaic with a sun in the far south of Thais.
Go to the sun mosaic in the **south of Thais** and **use** the pebbles in the centre (*"You discover something shiny that is hidden beneath the stones."*).
Needed to receive the {item:Empty Starlight Vial} and the {item:Dark Sun Catcher} in the next mission. Bring the {item:Panpipes}.

Enter Feyrist through an {wiki:Ice Shrine|Ice Shrine} (you arrive at a beach). Head **north** to the mermaid {npc:Aurita}. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}: she wants a spell to swap her tail for legs and go for a walk with {npc:Taegen}.
Go to the {npc:Dancing Fairy}, southeast of Aurita, and say {key:hi} and {key:fishtail} (or {key:spell}).
Playing the panpipes on the lake island

Go to Feyrist's big lake and enter the water from the **beach on the east side** of the lake. Swim to the island in the middle and, next to the magic fountain, **use** the {item:Panpipes}. You receive the {item:Magical Music Notes}.
Go back to {npc:Aurita} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to hand over the notes.
Talk to {npc:Taegen}: {key:hi} and {key:mission}. He wants a {item:Raven Herb}, which lets you breathe underwater.
**At night**, use one of the {wiki:Fern|ferns} scattered around Feyrist to pick a {item:Raven Herb}. The closest one is here:
Go back to {npc:Taegen} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
Help {npc:Maelyrra} rebuild the magic barrier that protects Feyrist from the nightmares of Roshamuul. Bring a melee weapon and 2 of each Small Enchanted gem.
Go to {npc:Maelyrra} in the centre of Feyrist, say {key:hi} and {key:mission} and offer your help against the invasion of nightmare creatures.
Kill **200** {creature:Enfeebled Silencer|Enfeebled Silencers} and {creature:Weakened Frazzlemaw|Weakened Frazzlemaws} in the cave next to the mountain.

Also kill the boss {creature:Kroazur}, whose lair is reached through the portal below, at the bottom of the nightmare creatures' cave (2 floors below the surface). The lair has free access and you can kill him **once every 2 real hours**. Good loot. To leave, go back the way you came and climb up to the surface of Feyrist.
Report and ask for the next mission
Go back to {npc:Maelyrra}, say {key:mission} to report and {key:mission} again for the next mission.
Mission 2: free 5 fairies and find the Dark Moon Mirror

There are 5 fairies trapped by dark creatures in three caves. In each one, **attack the energy barrier with a melee weapon** and then **use** the fairy. In the big cave you will also find the {item:Dark Moon Mirror}, inside a {wiki:Tree Stump (Feyrist)|tree stump}. To leave each cave, climb the same stairs you went down.
Small, north-west of the town area ({coord:33424,32215,7})
Small, south-west of the town area ({coord:33492,32292,7})
Big, south-east of the earth shrine ({coord:33554,32211,7}), floor -1
1 fairy at {coord:33559,32202,9} and the Dark Moon Mirror on the tree trunk at {coord:33593,32214,9}
Dark Moon Mirror on the Tree Stump (floor -2)
After a fairy is freed, it takes 1 minute to reappear for another player.

Go back to {npc:Maelyrra} and say {key:mission} to report. Ask for the next mission with {key:mission}: she sends you to get an {item:Empty Starlight Vial} from {npc:Aurita} and a {item:Dark Sun Catcher} from {npc:Taegen}.
Get the vial and the sun catcher

With *An Unlikely Couple* completed, talk to {npc:Aurita} to receive the {item:Empty Starlight Vial} and to {npc:Taegen}, to whom you must hand over **2 of each** {item:Small Enchanted Amethyst}, {item:Small Enchanted Emerald}, {item:Small Enchanted Ruby} and {item:Small Enchanted Sapphire}, to receive the {item:Dark Sun Catcher}. Then go back to {npc:Maelyrra} and say {key:mission}.
Go to the snake-head beach in the **north-east** of the island, **during the day**, and **use** the {item:Dark Sun Catcher}. You are left with a {item:Shining Sun Catcher}.
Go to the clearing **north-east** of the town, **at night**, and **use** the {item:Dark Moon Mirror}. You are left with a {item:Lit Moon Mirror}.
Climb the mountain to the {wiki:Energy Shrine|Energy Shrine}, **at night**, and **use** the {item:Empty Starlight Vial}. You are left with a {item:Gleaming Starlight Vial}.
Next to the Energy Shrine (starlight, floor +3)
With the three items charged, go back to {npc:Maelyrra} and say {key:mission}. Ask for the last mission with {key:mission}.
Each item has to be used in 5 places (15 in total). First: use the {item:Shining Sun Catcher} on the **5 Stone Mosaics**, **during the day**.
Use the {item:Gleaming Starlight Vial} on the **5 Dream Bird Trees**, **at night**.
Use the {item:Lit Moon Mirror} on the **5 Moon Sculptures**, **at night**. Four are at ground level and one is on the mountain (1 floor up, {coord:33511,32319,6}).
Sculpture on the mountain (1 floor up)
After all 15 places, go back to {npc:Maelyrra} and say {key:mission}. The barrier is strong again and she gives you a {item:Blossom Bag}. Your three light items go back to their empty/dark version.

After completing the 15 places, **do not recharge** the items before handing in the mission: you would end up with the quest version of the item, without defensive attributes, and there is no way to fix it (bug).
Recharge to get the final items

With the mission handed in, go back to the three charging spots at the right time of day and charge them again. They become permanently {item:Sun Catcher}, {item:Moon Mirror} and {item:Starlight Vial}, with elemental protection, and can be equipped in the Extra Slot.
Mountain next to the Energy Shrine ({coord:33529,32301,4})
You can only start after finishing *A Dream Come True*.
Talk to {npc:Valindara} **during the day** and say {key:hi} and {key:cloak} (swan cloak). She will make you a cloak if you bring her **100** {item:Swan Feather|Swan Feathers}.
**During the day**, step on the 8 spots next to the {creature:Swan|swans} of Feyrist. Each spot gives **5 feathers every 20 hours** (40 per day), so you need at least **3 days**.
With the 100 feathers, go back to {npc:Valindara} and say {key:cloak} and {key:yes}.
Wait **20 hours** and go back to {npc:Valindara}: {key:hi} and {key:cloak}.

Requires *A Dream Come True* completed. Bring invisibility ({item:Stealth Ring} or {spell:Invisible}), {item:Flour}, {item:Milk}, {item:Bar of Chocolate}, {item:Raspberry}, {item:Lemon} and {item:Moon Melon}.
In Feyrist, go to the **east** part of the island. When you see a huge donut, walk under it.

Talk to {npc:Maelyrra} and say {key:hi} and {key:donut}. The donut leads to {wiki:Candia|Candia}, but you need a {item:Gingerbread Key}. They have all been eaten and the recipe was stolen by a forest fury who ran away to Vandura.
Talk to the imprisoned forest fury

Leave Feyrist through any shrine and travel by boat to **Liberty Bay**. Enter the {wiki:Corym Black Market|Corym Black Market} through the sewer grate (Sewer Grate) shown below. Go down to floor -4 and talk to {npc:A Captive Forest Fury}: say {key:hi} and {key:help}. You need to make her invisible and create an illusion of her so the Coryms do not notice the escape.
Go down two more floors and pick up the {item:Intricate Cage Key}.

Go back up the same way to the surface of Liberty Bay (you come out through the sewer grate) and talk to {npc:Charlotta}: {key:hi} and {key:mirror image}. Pay her **1,000 gp** to create the illusion of the forest fury.

Become **invisible** ({spell:Invisible} or {item:Stealth Ring}) and go down again to the forest fury. **Use** the {item:Intricate Cage Key} on the cage and head back to the surface. When you get up there you receive the achievement **A Friend in Need** and the {item:Gingerbread Key Recipe}.
Do the whole trip (going down, opening the cage and coming up) invisible the entire time.

The recipe asks for key-shaped chocolate dough, with Moon Melon, Raspberry and Lemon syrups, baked in the Feyrist moulds. **Use** the {item:Flour} on a container with {item:Milk} to get a {item:Lump of Cake Dough}. Then use that dough on a {item:Bar of Chocolate} to get a {item:Lump of Chocolate Dough}.
Pick a {item:Moon Melon} on the surface of Feyrist (**night only**). Buy {item:Raspberry} and {item:Lemon} from {npc:Talila} or {npc:Valindara}, in Feyrist.
The {item:Sugar (Quest)|sugar} cubes are in three underground caves of Feyrist:
**Use** the sugar cubes on each fruit to get {item:Flask with Moon Melon Sirup}, {item:Flask with Raspberry Sirup} and {item:Flask with Lemon Sirup}.

Go to the oven in Feyrist and **use** the {item:Lump of Chocolate Dough} on it. Then use the syrups **in this order: moon melon, raspberry and lemon**. You receive the {item:Gingerbread Key (Moon Melon, Raspberry and Lemon)} and gain access to Candia.
The key appears on top of the oven: any player near you can pick it up.

With the {item:Gingerbread Key (Moon Melon, Raspberry and Lemon)}, go to the giant donut in the **east** part of Feyrist (if you are not in Feyrist, enter through a shrine, with a gem). Walk under it: the donut takes you to {wiki:Candia|Candia}.
Be able to talk to the NPCs

When you arrive in Candia, the NPCs only speak in gestures. **Greet the NPC downstairs first** and then climb to the top of the Gingerbread Castle, pick up the {item:Candy Lipstick} and **use it**. From then on you can talk to them.
Candy Lipstick, top of the Gingerbread Castle
If you have not greeted the NPC on the lower floor, you cannot pick up the lipstick.
Stolen Sweets: talk to the Sugar Plum Fairy
Talk to the {npc:Sugar Plum Fairy}, right below you: {key:hi} and {key:mission}. {creature:Kroazur} stole her favourite sweets and she wants you to get them back.

The sweets are with bosses outside Candia. Go back to Feyrist the same way you came in (the donut). From Feyrist, to get to the mainland, use any shrine (you do not need a gem). To return to Candia afterwards, follow the route from the step «Reach Candia».
Go to the lair of {creature:Kroazur} in Feyrist and kill him. You get the first sweet, the {item:Matcha Turtle}, and a note saying he sold the other sweets to other bosses.
Kill the bosses that ended up with the sweets and pick up each one. Each room has its own access (see the «Where» column); to leave each one, go back the same way you came in.
Lair at the bottom of the nightmare creatures' cave, in Feyrist
{wiki:Lion Sanctum|Lion Sanctum}, under Lion's Rock, north-west of Darashia (access through the mission *An Ancient Feud* of the {wiki:Grimvale Quest|Grimvale Quest})

{wiki:Asura Palace|Asura Palace}, near Kha'zeel Pass, in Tiquanda (access through the {wiki:Asura Palace Quest|Asura Palace Quest}: every 20 hours, after killing 3 {creature:Cave Hydra|Cave Hydras} and 2 {creature:Greater Fire Elemental|Greater Fire Elementals})
Top floor of the {wiki:Medusa Tower|Medusa Tower}, in the south-west of Tiquanda (near Port Hope): go down the hole north of the tower and enter the basement through a tunnel

Go back to Candia (shrine to Feyrist and then the donut) and talk to the {npc:Sugar Plum Fairy}. Say the name of each sweet ({key:Matcha Turtle}, {key:Rainbow Waffles}, {key:Rose Milk Cake}, {key:Nightsky Cupcake}). She thanks you and sends you to help in the chocolate mines.
Enter the hole of the chocolate mines and look for {npc:Candis}. Say {key:hi} and {key:mission}: some workers went to peek at a forbidden portal and got trapped.
Entrance hole of the Chocolate Mines
There are {creature:Nibblemaw|Nibblemaws} and {creature:Candy Horror|Candy Horrors} in the mines.

Enter the portal and kill {creature:Sugar Daddy} to free the workers. From time to time he summons small harmless candy fae: **kill them quickly**. If you do not kill them in time, you get a strong hex that greatly reduces your damage to the boss and your healing.
When you leave the room you see {creature:Sugar Cube Worker|Sugar Cube Workers} running away: you can kill them for the Bestiary without any consequences.
Report to Candis and pick up the candy canes
Go back to {npc:Candis} and say {key:mission}. He asks you to stabilise the mine. Open the chest right **north** of Candis and take the candy canes.
**Use** the candy canes on the broken part of the wall in three places: two on floor -1 of the mine and one on floor -2.

Go back to {npc:Candis}, say {key:mission} to report and {key:mission} again. He gives you 5 flasks. Go down to floor -2 and catch **5** {creature:Honey Elemental|Honey Elementals} with the flasks. Then go back and say {key:mission}.
Go back to floor -1 and climb up the same spot where you entered the mines, to return to the surface of Candia, near the entrance hole.
Candis sends you to the {npc:Sugar Plum Fairy}. Tell her {key:mission}: the Candy Carnival is open again and you can trade with {npc:Coco} and {npc:Toffee}, right south of the mines' entrance.
Talk to {npc:Dulcineo}: {key:hi} and {key:mission}. He is worried about the quarrel between the Sugar Plum Fairy and her sister, the Tooth Fairy, and asks you to talk to her.
Talk to the Tooth Fairy of Candia

The {npc:Tooth Fairy (Candia)} is in Feyrist, south-east of the fairy village: leave Candia the same way you came in (the donut) and go to her. Say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. Worried about the children's teeth because of the sweets, she wants you to bring toothbrushes to three children and put them on their pillows.
Put the toothbrushes on the beds
Leave Candia and Feyrist (donut and then any shrine) and go to the three houses. In each one, **use** the toothbrush on the head of the child's bed.
Rowenna, Carlin (the bed is on the upper floor)
Quero, Thais (the bed is on the upper floor)
Go back to Feyrist through a shrine (with a gem) and talk to the {npc:Tooth Fairy (Candia)}, south-east of the fairy village: say {key:mission}. You receive a {item:Pegasus Feather}.
Go back to Candia through the giant donut in the east of Feyrist and talk to {npc:Dulcineo}: say {key:mission} to finish *Sweet Dreams*.
This part gives no reward, but it is needed for the quest to be marked as complete.
Talk to the {npc:Sugar Plum Fairy} and say {key:taffy bunny}. Cherry, one of her bunnies, has disappeared.

Go down to the {wiki:Dessert Dungeons|Dessert Dungeons}, below the Gingerbread Castle: *"You discover a tuft of spun pink sugar on the floor. Could the missing taffy bunny Cherry be down here?"* appears. Run **south-west** and you will see {wiki:A Taffy Bunny|A Taffy Bunny} walking around. Try to interact with her: you get messages saying she is too fast for you to catch.

Climb out of the Dessert Dungeons the same way you went down and go back to the {npc:Sugar Plum Fairy}. Say {key:bunny}. The quest is complete. To leave Candia at the end, go back to Feyrist through the donut and use any shrine (no gem needed).
The parts *The Fairy Treasure* and *An Unlikely Couple* can be done in any order once you have access to Feyrist (the Fairy Treasure does not even need that access).
The boss {creature:Kroazur} can be killed once every 2 real hours and has good loot.
If you have already recharged the light items before handing in *A Dream Come True*, you end up with the quest version without defence (a bug with no known fix).
